sql: CREATE TABLE teams (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(description) <= 8192), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','disabled')), created_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), updated_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (updated_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms), version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1), UNIQUE (tenant_id,id), UNIQUE (tenant_id,name)); CREATE INDEX teams_tenant_status ON teams(tenant_id,status,id); CREATE TABLE team_memberships (tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, team_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('member','maintainer')), created_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,team_id,user_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,team_id) REFERENCES teams(tenant_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,user_id) REFERENCES human_user_tenant_bindings(tenant_id,user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE); CREATE INDEX team_memberships_user ON team_memberships(tenant_id,user_id,team_id); CREATE TABLE repository_access_grants (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), repository_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT, team_id TEXT, permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (permission IN ('read','write','admin')), created_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), updated_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (updated_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms), version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1), CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL AND team_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND team_id IS NOT NULL)), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,user_id) REFERENCES human_user_tenant_bindings(tenant_id,user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,team_id) REFERENCES teams(tenant_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX repository_access_grants_unique_user ON repository_access_grants(tenant_id,repository_id,user_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX repository_access_grants_unique_team ON repository_access_grants(tenant_id,repository_id,team_id) WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX repository_access_grants_repository ON repository_access_grants(tenant_id,repository_id,id); CREATE INDEX repository_access_grants_user ON repository_access_grants(tenant_id,user_id,repository_id); CREATE INDEX repository_access_grants_team ON repository_access_grants(tenant_id,team_id,repository_id);
